perf_log_entry_t

One record in the in-memory performance log. Throughput fields are populated for PERF_LOG_TYPE_THROUGHPUT; latency fields are populated for PERF_LOG_TYPE_LATENCY.

Fields
seq

Monotonic sequence number assigned when the entry is stored.

type

PERF_LOG_TYPE_THROUGHPUT or PERF_LOG_TYPE_LATENCY.

tag

NUL-terminated label stored with the measurement.

status

Caller-supplied status associated with the result.

bytes

Byte count for a throughput result.

elapsed_us

Elapsed time in microseconds for a throughput result.

kib_per_sec

Throughput in KiB per second.

mbps_x1000

Throughput in megabits per second multiplied by 1000.

samples

Sample count for a latency result.

min_ns

Minimum latency in nanoseconds.

avg_ns

Average latency in nanoseconds.

max_ns

Maximum latency in nanoseconds.
